text:
Samira (PM): quick sync for the 'regional-fallback lattice' rollout. goal: NA opt-in alpha, EU shadow for 48h, APAC gated. need clear per-tenant pre-approval + audit path.
Jae (Eng): high-level: feature-flag + three cohorts: baseline, v1, and a persistent 1% holdback. Flow: EU shadow 10% -> NA opt-in visible 4% -> 20% -> manual gating to 80/100. Include an adaptive-decay controller to automatically halve traffic on short-term p99 spikes.
Mateo (SRE): infra constraints: reserve warm canary pools in us-east and eu-west. Alarms: sustained p99>340ms OR 5xx>0.6% for 8m -> auto-decay; unresolved after 6m -> rollback and page. Add per-tenant kill switch and tenant-blackout windows so scheduled-maintenance tenants are excluded from visible assignments.
Pri (Data): telemetry checklist: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, 5xx%, token-cost delta, rolling quality delta on seeded evals, and per-cohort counts. Quick smoke will use a 2k spot-check; full A/B needs ~10k requests/arm for ~1.5% detectable delta. I'll prepare dashboards and a lift/diff panel that updates every 15m.
Samira (PM): launch gates: smoke at 4% (no infra alarms, quick smoke pass), pause-and-review at 20% (manual sign-off), full roll only if quality delta <=1.2% and no major infra alarms for 24h. Enterprise tenants must have pre_approved flag set to be assigned visible variants.
Jae (Eng): draft flag snippet for ops-config (paste):
```
{"flag":"regional_fallback_lattice_v1","mode":"opt_in","variants":[{"name":"baseline","ratio":0.96},{"name":"v1","ratio":0.04}],"shadow":{"EU":0.10},"holdback":0.01,"auto_decay":{"metric":"p99","pct_threshold":20,"decay_factor":0.5},"kill_switch":"global_off","tenant_preapproval_field":"pre_approved","tenant_blackout_field":"blackout_windows"}
```
Mateo (SRE): fallback choreography: 1) auto-decay when threshold breached; 2) try quantized-gpu fallback for 2m; 3) if still unhealthy, route that tenant traffic to baseline and emit an incident marker. Also add a rolling QPS cap per-tenant to prevent noisy-neighbor induced regressions.
rollout-bot: scheduled shadow_start: 2026-08-10T03:00Z, visible_na_start: 2026-08-13T16:00Z
Pri (Data): sample sizing note: for the quick smoke we'll rely on the 2k human-labeled spot-check; for A/B stats I'll seed 10k requests per arm and create a p-value dashboard. Also adding an automatic check that blocks ramp if sample counts are below expected.
Samira (PM): enterprise ask: Customer Delta requires EU-only exposure and a signed pre-approval workflow. We need tamper-evident audit entries for any manual override.
Mateo (SRE): we'll emit audit events: "audit:flag-assign:{tenant}:{approver}:{ts}" into the audit stream and store signed metadata in the audit bucket. I'll add pre-approval enforcement in the rollout controller so visible assignment never occurs without the pre_approved marker.
Jae (Eng): infra todos:
- implement flag schema + pre-approval checker
- adaptive-decay controller + fallback hooks
- shadow routing + holdback cohort
Mateo (SRE): SRE todos:
- reserve canary pools + pre-warm caches
- alarm rules, per-tenant killpath, audit event plumbing
Pri (Data): data todos: eval harness + dashboards + sampling queries
Samira (PM): comms/runbook: I'll draft tenant comms, rollback FAQ, and a concise decision matrix for pre-approval handling. Target soft launch week: 2026-08-12.
Samira (PM): blockers? :eyes:
Jae (Eng): need adaptive-decay CI green by 2026-08-09.
Mateo (SRE): will block if canary pools are not reserved or if audit pipeline not emitting signed events.
Pri (Data): dashboards ETA: 2026-08-08 EOD.
Samira (PM): thanks folks 44d I'll post the final runbook in #launchroom after pre-canary review and PR merges. tagging @Jae @Mateo @Pri for follow-up.
